places.name: Tortuguero Canals Boat Tour
places.ai_summary: The Tortuguero Canals offer a serene boat tour through lush rainforests, providing opportunities to spot exotic wildlife like monkeys, caimans, and colorful birds.

opening_hours.notes: Tours are weather-dependent.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for better wildlife viewing.
places.address: Tortuguero Canals, Limón Province, Costa Rica

attribution.title: Tortuguero, Costa Rica
attribution.author: John Menard from Phoenix, USA

places.name: Turtle Nesting Beach (July–Oct)
places.ai_summary: The Turtle Nesting Beach is a protected area where visitors can witness sea turtles nesting and hatching during the season. It's a unique and unforgettable experience.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are mandatory to protect the turtles.

places.place_tip: Wear dark clothing and avoid using flash photography.
places.address: Turtle Nesting Beach, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Sea Turtle Conservancy Museum
places.ai_summary: The Sea Turtle Conservancy Museum educates visitors about the conservation efforts to protect sea turtles. It features interactive exhibits and informative displays.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on major holidays.

places.place_tip: Make a donation to support turtle conservation efforts.
places.address: Sea Turtle Conservancy Museum, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Cerro Tortuguero Viewpoint Hike
places.ai_summary: The Cerro Tortuguero Viewpoint Hike is a challenging trail that rewards hikers with panoramic views of Tortuguero and the surrounding rainforest.

opening_hours.notes: Best hiked with a guide. Bring water and snacks.

places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes and bring a camera.
places.address: Cerro Tortuguero, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Tortuguero Village Walk
places.ai_summary: The Tortuguero Village Walk is a cultural tour that takes you through the village, showcasing local life, architecture, and community projects.

opening_hours.notes: Wear comfortable shoes and be respectful of local customs.

places.place_tip: Learn some basic Spanish phrases to communicate with locals.
places.address: Tortuguero Village, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Jaguar Trail (Rainforest Hike)
places.ai_summary: The Jaguar Trail is a guided hike through the rainforest, where you can learn about the ecosystem and possibly spot a jaguar.

opening_hours.notes: Best with a guide. Bring insect repellent.

places.place_tip: Stay quiet and patient for wildlife spotting.
places.address: Jaguar Trail, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Birdwatching Canoe Tour
places.ai_summary: The Birdwatching Canoe Tour is a peaceful canoe trip through the wetlands, ideal for observing a wide variety of bird species in their natural habitat.

opening_hours.notes: Early morning tours are best for birdwatching.

places.place_tip: Bring a hat, sunscreen, and binoculars.
places.address: Birdwatching Canoe Tour, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Night Turtle Patrol (Guided)
places.ai_summary: The Night Turtle Patrol is a guided night tour where you can observe sea turtles nesting on the beach. It's a unique and educational experience.

opening_hours.notes: Reservations are required. Limited spots available.

places.place_tip: Follow the guide's instructions to avoid disturbing the turtles.
places.address: Night Turtle Patrol, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Kayak in Jungle Canals
places.ai_summary: Kayaking in the jungle canals of Tortuguero is an adventurous way to explore the rainforest. Keep an eye out for wildlife along the waterways.

opening_hours.notes: Wear a swimsuit and water shoes. Bring a change of clothes.

places.place_tip: Listen to the sounds of the jungle and enjoy the tranquility.
places.address: Kayak in Jungle Canals, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Tortuguero National Park Entrance
places.ai_summary: The entrance to Tortuguero National Park is the starting point for many adventures in the park. It provides access to the park's trails, canals, and wildlife.

opening_hours.notes: Check for park alerts or closures before visiting.

places.place_tip: Visit the park's official website for the latest information.
places.address: Tortuguero National Park Entrance, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Rainforest Photography Tour
places.ai_summary: The Rainforest Photography Tour is a guided tour that takes you through the rainforest to capture stunning photos of the diverse flora and fauna.

opening_hours.notes: Bring your camera and tripod. Dress for the weather.

places.place_tip: Ask the guide for tips on capturing wildlife photos.
places.address: Rainforest Photography Tour, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

attribution.title: Tapanti
attribution.author: No machine-readable author provided. Mardochaios assumed (based on copyright claims).
attribution.description: This is a photo I took of a waterfall from the main observatory of the Tapantí National Park in Costa Rica. This picture was taken on August 14, 2005. Tapantc National Park, sometimes called Orosí National Park, is a National Park in the Pacific La Amistad Conservation Area of Costa Rica located on the edge of the Talamanca Range, near Cartago. It protects forests to the north of Chirripó National Park, and also contains part of the Orosí River.

places.name: Local Chocolate Workshop
places.ai_summary: The Local Chocolate Workshop offers a delicious and educational experience where you can learn about chocolate making and taste fresh, organic chocolate.

opening_hours.notes: Reservations recommended for groups.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the chance to buy some chocolate souvenirs.
places.address: Local Chocolate Workshop, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

attribution.title: Santa Claus Parade Toronto 2009 (3)

places.name: Tortuguero Airstrip Views
places.ai_summary: The Tortuguero Airstrip offers unique views of the Tortuguero area from above. It's a great spot for photography and to see the layout of the land.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy the views.
places.address: Tortuguero Airstrip, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

attribution.title: Tortuguero, Costa Rica
attribution.author: John Menard from Phoenix, USA

places.name: Fishing Village Market
places.ai_summary: The Fishing Village Market is a local market where you can buy fresh seafood, fruits, vegetables, and other local products. It's a great place to experience local life.

opening_hours.notes: Best to visit in the morning for fresh products.

places.place_tip: Try to speak some Spanish to interact with the vendors.
places.address: Fishing Village Market, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Canal Boat Transfer Experience
places.ai_summary: The Canal Boat Transfer Experience is a unique boat ride that takes you through the canals of Tortuguero, offering a different perspective of the area.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for departure times.

places.place_tip: Keep your camera ready for wildlife sightings.
places.address: Canal Boat Transfer Experience, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Caño Palma Biological Station
places.ai_summary: The Caño Palma Biological Station is a research station and eco-tourism destination. It offers guided tours to explore the rich biodiversity of the area.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking is required for tours.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars and a camera for wildlife viewing.
places.address: Caño Palma Biological Station, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Sunrise over the Caribbean
places.ai_summary: Watching the sunrise over the Caribbean from Tortuguero is a breathtaking experience. The vibrant colors and serene setting make it a must-see.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed from the beach or a boat.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to find a good viewing spot.
places.address: Sunrise Viewing Area, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Manatee Sighting (Caño Chiquero)
places.ai_summary: Caño Chiquero is a great spot for observing manatees in their natural habitat. These gentle giants are often seen grazing in the shallow waters.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited with a guide. Bring water and snacks.

places.place_tip: Be quiet and patient for the best chance to see manatees.
places.address: Caño Chiquero, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Butterfly House
places.ai_summary: The Butterfly House is a serene garden where you can observe and learn about various species of butterflies in a natural setting.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on major holidays.

places.place_tip: Visit the gift shop for unique butterfly-themed souvenirs.
places.address: Butterfly House, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

places.name: Local Caribbean Cuisine Tasting
places.ai_summary: Experience the flavors of the Caribbean with a tasting tour of local dishes. It's a delicious way to learn about the culture.

opening_hours.notes: Reservations recommended for groups.

places.place_tip: Try the rice and beans, fresh fish, and coconut desserts.
places.address: Local Caribbean Cuisine Tasting, Tortuguero, Limón Province, Costa Rica

attribution.author: Richie Diesterheft from Chicago, IL, USA
attribution.description: A Costa Rican lunch, called casado. Comes with rice, fried plantain, onioned meat (chicken or beef), an egg, beans and a cabbage salad sprinkled with lemon juice and salt.
